Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
mesos.offer.OfferTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OfferTile extends Object implements Serializable
One Offer Tile on the offer track. Holds its pick budget (top/bottom cards + direct food bonus), the player-count restriction, and the totem currently parked on it. Validation of a player's choice is delegated to OfferChoiceValidator.
